standard.summary: 为 LOMO/AdaLOMO 这类「反传中逐参数就地更新」的融合反传优化器选择梯度裁剪档位：default 单遍反传不裁剪，full 额外跑一次预反传让 max_grad_norm 真正生效。
standard.effect: default（默认）：保持单遍反传，梯度算完立即用掉并释放，max_grad_norm 拿不到全局梯度范数，裁剪被上报为 not_applied；full：每步先做一次 retain_graph 的 grad_norm 预反传，再做正式反传，裁剪真实生效，但反传开销约翻倍。
standard.whenToUse: 用 LOMO/AdaLOMO 做全参微调且训练发散、确实需要梯度裁剪兜底时选 full；显存和速度优先、训练本身稳定时保持 default。
standard.avoidWhen: 非 LOMO 家族优化器时此项不生效；max_grad_norm ≤ 0 时选 full 也会被自动回落为 default（后端配置校验器会主动降级，避免白付预反传成本）。

standard_en.summary: Selects the gradient clipping gear for fused-backward optimizers such as LOMO/AdaLOMO, which update each parameter in place during backward: default keeps a single backward pass with no clipping, full runs an extra pre-backward so max_grad_norm really takes effect.
standard_en.effect: default (the default) keeps the single backward pass -- each gradient is used and freed as soon as it is computed, so max_grad_norm never sees a global gradient norm and clipping is reported as not_applied. full runs a retain_graph grad_norm pre-backward each step before the real backward, so clipping genuinely applies at roughly double the backward cost.
standard_en.whenToUse: Choose full when doing a full finetune with LOMO/AdaLOMO, training diverges, and you really need clipping as a safety net; keep default when VRAM and speed come first and training is stable anyway.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It does nothing outside the LOMO family. With max_grad_norm <= 0, choosing full is downgraded to default automatically (the backend's config validator does this deliberately, so the pre-backward cost is not paid for nothing).

advanced.principle: LOMO 的省显存来源是「反传到哪个参数就立即更新并丢掉梯度」，因此永远不存在完整梯度向量，常规 clip_grad_norm 无从谈起。full 档通过先跑一次只求全局梯度范数的反传（retain_graph=True），把范数传给优化器的 clip_grad_norm 属性，第二次反传时按比例缩放更新。
advanced.intervention: 配置层：configs.py 的 model_validator 归一化取值并在 max_grad_norm≤0 时降级为 default；执行层：training_step_optimizer_execution_handler.py 按档位组装 fused_grad_clip_contract，档位为 default 时上报 fallback_reason=fused_backward_grad_clip_mode_default 与补救提示。
advanced.expectedImpact: full 档使 LOMO 训练在梯度尖峰时更稳；代价是每步两次反传，吞吐约减半。
advanced.tradeoffs: default 最快最省显存但放弃裁剪保护；full 抵消了 LOMO 的一部分速度优势。运行契约（applied/not_applied）会写进训练报告，便于事后核对裁剪是否真实生效。
advanced.codePath: configs.py:_validate_fused_backward_grad_clip_mode；training_step_optimizer_execution_handler.py:fused_grad_clip 契约组装；optimizer_step_contracts.py 说明 full 档的 grad_norm 预反传语义

advanced_en.principle: LOMO's VRAM savings come from "update and discard the gradient the moment backward reaches a parameter", so a full gradient vector never exists and conventional clip_grad_norm is impossible. The full tier first runs one backward pass that only computes the global gradient norm (retain_graph=True), passes the norm to the optimizer's clip_grad_norm attribute, and scales the second backward's update proportionally.
advanced_en.intervention: Config layer: configs.py's model_validator normalizes the value and downgrades to default when max_grad_norm≤0; execution layer: training_step_optimizer_execution_handler.py assembles fused_grad_clip_contract per tier, reporting fallback_reason=fused_backward_grad_clip_mode_default with remediation hints on the default tier.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: The full tier steadies LOMO training under gradient spikes; the cost is two backward passes per step, roughly halving throughput.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: default is fastest and most VRAM-friendly but gives up clipping protection; full negates part of LOMO's speed advantage. The run contract (applied/not_applied) is written into the training report for post-hoc verification that clipping really took effect.
advanced_en.codePath: configs.py:_validate_fused_backward_grad_clip_mode; training_step_optimizer_execution_handler.py:fused_grad_clip contract assembly; optimizer_step_contracts.py documents the full tier's grad_norm pre-backward semantics
